field_components.field_note_para:
• The above data display includes demand for UPI & Non-UPI bids. In case of UPI bids, only bids with status as RC100 – “Mandate Accepted by Investor and amount Blocked” are displayed
  • The final demand display of UPI Bids shall be updated upto 7:00 PM on the last day of IPO/FPO.
  • The display with respect to “No of Applications Received” for SME IPO is effective from July 03, 2024.
